ns2:section.sectionText: This course is available to undergrads as an online Academic Year term offering. See https://netmath.illinois.edu/college/math-461. XGR Section restricted to Engineering Online graduate degree-seeking students in MSAE, MSCE, MCS, MSIE, and MSME. For more details on this course section, see http://engineering.illinois.edu/online/courses/. Non-degree students please register for MATH 461 M16 section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Civil Engr - Online - UIUC, MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, MS:Industrial Engr Online-UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, MS:Env Engr CivilEngr ONL-UIUC, MS: Aerospace Engr-Online-UIUC, or MENG:Mech Engineering Onl-UIUC.
